package_info.package_name: JFrog Xray SIEM Plugin for Splunk
package_info.package_versions: Initial release (2021-05, as shown in logs)
package_info.why_malicious: Not malicious. This package is a security integration tool designed to forward vulnerability and license compliance data from JFrog Xray to Splunk SIEM for enhanced DevSecOps visibility and response. No evidence of malicious code or behavior is present in the report.

behavioral_signatures: Real-time forwarding of vulnerability and license compliance events from JFrog Xray to Splunk
Mapping of Xray data to Splunk’s Common Information Model (CIM)
Dashboard visualization of security and license violations, impacted artifacts, and components
file_indicators: No suspicious file patterns; expected files include Splunk dashboard configurations and Xray event logs
network_indicators: API calls to JFrog Xray endpoints (e.g., /xray/api/v1/violations)
Internal communication between JFrog Xray and Splunk Enterprise
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for expected API calls from the JFrog Xray SIEM Plugin to Splunk and ensure all data mappings conform to Splunk’s CIM. No malicious activity is expected; any unexpected outbound network connections or file modifications outside the described integration scope should be investigated.
